"""Worst-case plan performance: 4096 requests, 8192 offers, 262144 pairs."""
import base64, json, os, random, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')

def execute(path,data,work):
    import resource
    limits=[(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(2048*1024**2,)*2),(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(170,175)),
            (resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE,(64*1024**2,)*2),(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE,(64,64)),
            (resource.RLIMIT_NPROC,(1,1)),(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))]
    def pre():
        os.umask(0o077)
        for key,value in limits:
            try: resource.setrlimit(key,value)
            except (ValueError,OSError): pass
    env={'PATH':'/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin','LANG':'C','LC_ALL':'C','TMPDIR':str(work)}
    started=time.monotonic()
    p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(path)],cwd=work,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=env,preexec_fn=pre)
    out,err=p.communicate(data,timeout=400)
    return out,err,p.returncode,time.monotonic()-started

def build(seed,nreq=4096,noffer=8192,pairs=262144,distinct_cost=True):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    import ipaddress
    from gen_targets import plan as plan_targets
    nlease=nreq//32
    leases=[]
    for i in range(nlease):
        leases.append({'id':'L%04d'%i,
                       'prefix':'2001:db8:%x:%x::/56'%(rng.randint(0,65535),rng.randint(0,15)<<12),
                       'start':0,'end':1000,'subnets':[0],'low_count':32})
    manifest,lookup,lowset=plan_targets({l['id']:dict(l,network=ipaddress.IPv6Network(l['prefix']),
                                                      subnets=[0]) for l in leases},'demo')
    HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,'
            'result,service,attempt,payload')
    rows=[]
    chosen=[]
    for m in manifest:
        lease,probe,target=m['lease'],m['probe'],m['target']
        if not probe.endswith('c'):
            rows.append(f'icmp,{lease.replace("L","p")}{probe.split("/")[1]},0,5,put,{lease},1,{probe},{target},{target},echo,,,')
            if len(chosen)<nreq: chosen.append((lease,target))
    chosen=chosen[:nreq]
    data=('\r\n'.join([HEADER]+rows)+'\r\n').encode()
    captures=[{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(data).decode()]}]
    requests=[]
    for i,(lease,target) in enumerate(chosen):
        requests.append({'id':'r%05d'%i,'at':10,'lease':lease,'target':target,
                         'service':'web','group':'g%05d'%i})
    # star forests
    rq=[{'id':'qroot','parent':None,'capacity':nreq}]
    rq+= [{'id':'g%05d'%i,'parent':'qroot','capacity':1} for i in range(len(requests))]
    offers=[]
    ids=[r['id'] for r in requests]
    per=max(1,pairs//noffer)
    for i in range(noffer):
        listed=sorted(rng.sample(ids,min(per,len(ids))))
        offers.append({'id':'o%05d'%i,'time':20,'service':'web','prefix':'2001:db8::/32',
                       'capacity':1,'cost':(i if distinct_cost else 1),'group':'o',
                       'requests':listed})
    og=[{'id':'oroot','parent':None,'capacity':nreq},
        {'id':'o','parent':'oroot','capacity':noffer}]
    return {'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':leases,
            'services':[{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'}],'queries':[10],
            'captures':captures,'requests':requests,'offers':offers,
            'request_quotas':rq,'offer_quotas':og}

def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        tmp=Path(tmp); root=tmp/'root'; root.mkdir()
        (root/'deps').symlink_to(Path('/workspace/deps'),target_is_directory=True)
        sub=root/'submission'
        subprocess.run(['cp','-r','/workspace/submission',str(sub)],check=True)
        for name,kw in (('full',dict()),('uniform-cost',dict(distinct_cost=False)),
                        ('half',dict(nreq=1024,noffer=2048,pairs=65536))):
            job=build(7,**kw)
            raw=json.dumps(job,separators=(',',':')).encode()
            work=tmp/('w-'+name); work.mkdir()
            out,err,code,seconds=execute(sub/'campaign.py',raw,work)
            print(f'{name}: in={len(raw)/1e6:.1f}MB seconds={seconds:.1f} exit={code} '
                  f'err={err.decode()[:300]}',flush=True)
            if code==0:
                result=json.loads(out)
                print('   plan',result['plan']['resolved'],result['plan']['cost'],
                      'active',sum(1 for a in result['active_requests'] if a['active']),
                      'pairs',sum(len(o['requests']) for o in job['offers']))

if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
PYEOF
